data_fields.name: fade_latency
data_fields.donor_constant: one mix block (MIXBUFFER_SAMPLES; value not read)

best_idea: A fade that is a start and end time plus a dB target, retargeted from its current value so a new fade never jumps, applied per channel and per class as a product of gains, so a boss intro can duck the ambience class and a teleport can duck it with a sting on top.
decision_why: The donor has per-channel and per-class fades but no zone bed, so we pair two fades for the crossfade and keep the retarget-from-current rule; the one-step no-dups bump is a defect, fixed with a bounded loop that skips playing samples.
acceptance: Client test with a fake clock: crossfading bed A to bed B over 2.0 s gives A falling and B rising, with no jump when a second zone change lands halfway through; a boss intro ducks the ambience class to -20 dB within 0.5 s and restores it after the intro.
